newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.011pts to 100.592.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.011pts to 100.592.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.011 points in Monday's trading to 100.592, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.001 points to 2.558 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.016 points to 96.706, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.334 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.354 points to 1,150.736.
